content: Scope creep from tracker to ERP maps to the Brooks second-system effect: after a simple system works, confidence drives over-engineered expansion; ResearchGate empirical study names scope creep among the most common causes of software project failure. Antidotes from Retool build-vs-buy guide, HN threads, Envy Labs: freeze MVP scope in writing, explicit out-of-scope list, YAGNI, fast feedback before expansion. Project already has an Out of Scope section in PROJECT.md that should be defended.
